respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture represents a multi-tenant ticketing and e-commerce platform. It features two user entry points on the whiteboard: an administrative tenant setting up tenancy and end-user customers browsing/purchasing. Both connect through a CDN. Static web content is served from S3 back to the client. Tenant provisioning flows through AWS AppSync (GraphQL with pipeline resolvers) triggering Lambda, which uses SQS for asynchronous fan-out processing and persists configuration in DynamoDB. In parallel, API Gateway handles customer/third-party API requests, connecting to DynamoDB (as drawn) and invoking backend Lambdas (as spoken).
respuesta.nombre: Multi-Tenant Serverless Application with AppSync and API Gateway
